decisions.reason: The original Q[P] predicate exceeded its supplier domain. The current process supplier now defines Q on all P_s; the Definition explicitly states that domain and preserves the original admitted witnesses without extending the core-only energy law.

The general bulk postulate designates optional scale tags with partial B_c,lambda domains, so universal scaling was unsupported. Added an explicit fully scalable family with bijective full-domain coordinate maps, full finite products, and reversible coherent tag/preparation transport; no empirical universal-scaling claim is inferred.

A4 previously applied every positive scale without total scale-map existence. Its Postulate now expressly uses the fully scalable supplier family and coherent transport, so A4–A6 have defined operands. A3 spectator availability follows from full finite state products; all are adopted model assumptions.

The old second T2 clause repeated A5 and omitted thermal equilibrium of the scaled copies. Restored the typed join (u,tv,(1-t)v) equivalent to the separated scaled pair; equivalence of that pair to x remains supplied separately by A5 and A2. Source IV.A T2 has exactly the join-to-pair clause.

Equal formal mass does not authorize a change of primitive composition. The example now explicitly supplies one formal endpoint channel per equal-mass type pair, exact configuration/endpoints/protocol/transfer data and admitted records determined by the entropy inequality. This preserves all original comparisons and supplies their witnesses. Scaled T2 is also checked against the actual joined state.

The contact supplier Proof1.1 already constructs a weighted encoding, so omission from its Statement alone is not a fatal output gap. However the consumer attributed the construction to its pairwise fact and, more seriously, quantified over finite join-closed families, a vacuous condition for retained tagged joins. Repaired the actual missing full-contact premise using closures of finite generators, constructed the encoding directly from exact mathematical definitions, and proved reversible extension from primitive products to joined states. The original entropy conclusion is retained.

A core process has six fields while a channel has seven, and whole-process transfer functionals were not supplied as maps of r alone. Added the fixed-boundary insertion/deletion bijection onto the exact core admitted subset and used complete-record transfer maps. No-matter-crossing and kinetic/external restrictions are carried through. Also separated empty raw channel data from the nonempty reflexive A1–A6 network subclass.

The finite-factor-closed network Definition expressly requires EACH channel to preserve dimensionless formal mass. The Statement assumes precisely that subclass, so every admitted channel meets the equal-mass hypothesis of the cost inference. The proof correctly combines its real cost lower bound with the additive offset bound under no-sinks and Choice; the rejected missing-mass claim is false.
